events.name: Bash
events.head: Locate s3 guide and count capture_needed
events.input: $ grep -rln "s3-tantra-pro-flow" app/src/lib/guides 2>/dev/null | head -3; f=$(grep -rl "s3-tantra-pro-flow" app/src/content app/src/lib/guides 2>/dev/null | head -1); echo $f; grep -c "capture_needed" $f 2>/dev/null

events.name: Bash
events.head: Show which s3 steps still need capture
events.input: $ grep -n "capture_needed\|^\s*n: \|step:" app/src/content/guides/s3-nurture/s3-tantra-pro-flow.ts | grep -B1 capture_needed | head -20; ls ../tantra-frontend-v2 2>/dev/null | head -2
